scoring_justification: Cannot recompute DFT/BoltzTraP results; score by comparing agent's reported values and trends to paper-reported gold with tolerances and threshold-or-better policies.

hidden_assets.purpose: Hidden gold values for phonon stability and all fields of results_summary.json, taken directly from the paper's reported numbers.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Extracted from paper text: lattice constant a=6.347 Å, band gaps 0.69 eV (no SOC), 0.73 eV (SOC), max Seebeck -493 µV/K at 900 K and n=2e19 cm⁻³, ZT_e=0.95 at 10¹⁹ cm⁻³, pressure-dependent values from Fig.6/Fig.7, absorption trend from Fig.8.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: All gold values are the paper's exact reported numbers for the same quantities, conditions, and units, ensuring the hidden gold is the authoritative reproduction target.

schema.description: One line per strain in format 'ε = <strain>%: stable' or 'unstable'

outputs.description: Declares the dynamical stability of ScRhTe at each applied strain based on the absence of imaginary phonon modes.
Aggregated key properties of ScRhTe at equilibrium and under pressure, to be compared against paper-reported values with tolerances and trend checks.

output_contract.notes: The checker compares the phonon_stability.txt lines to expected stability (all strains stable). For results_summary.json, each field is compared to the hidden gold with appropriate tolerances; the absorption coefficient at +4% must be larger than at 0% (trend).
